name: mabl
description: Independent verification for agentic development using the world's most advanced testing harness. Create, run, and debug mabl end-to-end tests directly from your coding agent.

showSessionSteps.title: Show mabl results in side panel
showSessionSteps.description: Polls each running test authoring session for the steps it has generated (step groups and flows included) and shows them in its tab.

stepsPollSeconds.title: Test authoring steps refresh (seconds)
stepsPollSeconds.description: How often to fetch the steps of a running test authoring session. Each fetch downloads the whole session.
